tasks.title: Refactor NeoMud Three toward bird eye click to move play
tasks.description: Explore and implement a click-first play mode for NeoMud Three: Diablo 3-inspired elevated camera, click-to-move, clickable world landmarks/exits/interactables, readable loot/NPC affordances, room-to-room action-RPG flow, and reduced reliance on camera-facing sign labels that can clip into geometry. Keep server-authoritative movement: clicking a destination should route through the same move/interaction command path as physical triggers and UI controls. StarCraft II and Dota are camera clarity references; Diablo is the closest mechanics target for a single controllable character.

comments.body: User clarified target feel: StarCraft II / Dota-like camera and interaction, not first-person or third-person chase. Refined target: Diablo-like is probably the better fit for NeoMud Three than RTS/MOBA. Single-character click-to-move, elevated readable camera, click NPCs/items/exits, room graph remains server-authoritative.

Product direction clarified: ship a game obviously heavily inspired by Diablo 3 mechanics. Prioritize elevated/isometric camera, click-to-move, click attacks/interactions/exits, readable loot/NPC affordances, room-to-room flow, and action-RPG pacing. Preserve NeoMud server authority and MUD room graph under the presentation layer.

First visual-mode slice implemented: HUD camera toggle supports Platform and Iso. Platform preserves the current behind-character pointer-lock view; Iso provides elevated ARPG camera and keeps cursor visible for future click-to-move. Next slice should add ground raycast click target, destination marker, and clickable exits through the existing move command path.

First click-to-move slice implemented: Iso mode canvas clicks raycast to the ground plane, clamp through room runtime, show a destination marker, and steer the avatar toward the target. Keyboard movement cancels the click target. QA includes debug API movement plus real browser mouse click in Town Square Iso screenshot test. Remaining gap: direct click selection for exits/NPCs/items.

Direct click routing added: ground clicks now check nearby interactables and exit trigger volumes before defaulting to movement. Town Square QA verifies Old Wren click selection opens the interaction panel and North Gate trigger click routes to town:gate through the existing move path. Remaining gap: hover/selection feedback and pathing.

First hover targeting slice implemented: Iso mode classifies pointer/ground targets, shows a world hover marker plus concise Click prompt for NPCs/items/exits, and clears hover on click, room switch, player placement, pointer leave, or panel state. Town Square screenshot QA now verifies Old Wren hover and North Gate hover before existing click routing.

Selection affordance slice added: clicking an interactable in Iso mode now leaves a selected-target world ring while the interaction panel is open, and body cursor state changes on hoverable NPC/item/exit targets. Town Square screenshot QA now captures isometric-selection-target and budget remains within the 240-call gate.

Target prompt semantics tightened: hover/proximity labels now use entity prompt/action data so normal NPCs read Talk to, hostiles read Engage, objects read Inspect, and loot reads Pick up. Offline smoke QA now asserts Forest Rat and Shadow Wolf hover/proximity labels read as Engage.

Selection lifetime tightened: selected-target ring is now scoped to the interaction panel and clears on Escape/close or when opening a non-interaction panel. Town Square screenshot QA asserts the marker clears after closing Old Wren.

Iso click-and-hold movement added: primary pointer down on open ground starts hold movement, pointer drag updates the destination marker continuously, and pointer release stops hold state while preserving the active destination. Town Square screenshot QA uses a real mouse drag and captures isometric-hold-move.

Iso camera zoom added: mouse wheel in Iso mode adjusts a bounded zoom multiplier used by the render-engine isometric camera. Debug API exposes cameraControls, and Town Square screenshot QA verifies wheel-down zooms out and wheel-up zooms back in.

First hostile target affordance slice added: hostile interactables use red selected-target marker colors and the interaction panel renders a compact hostile target frame with deterministic health bar. Smoke QA verifies Giant Forest Spider opens the hostile target frame. This is target UI only, not a local combat simulation.
